about: How tools/pack.py builds Goblins vs Gnomes 2014 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on Naxxramas (base), so on Classic: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the Goblins vs Gnomes cards and their tokens (data/gvg_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set gvg) with the names and texts of the release build 7234 for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the release stats, tribes and keywords, the Mechs and the balance changes of that day, the scripts of scripts/gvg.lua).
